episodes.synopsis: As the descendant of the hero, Kunon Gurion was born blind, and he’s determined to make eyes using his magic.
episodes.title: The World in Colors

episodes.synopsis: When Kunon goes to the school for noble children to take exams, he encounters a challenge.
episodes.title: To the School for Noble Children

episodes.synopsis: Kunon graduates and Miss Jenie resigns. Kunon wants a Royal Sorcerer for his new teacher.
episodes.title: Graduation, and What’s Next?

episodes.synopsis: Kunon goes to the castle to meet the Royal Sorcerers to be tested and meets Raysha, Mirika’s older sister.
episodes.title: Off to the Castle

episodes.synopsis: After passing the test at the Black Tower, Kunon finally meets his new master.
episodes.title: Quite A Boy and A New Master

episodes.synopsis: Studying under Zeonly, Kunon finally learns the skills he needs to make eyeballs.
episodes.title: Incredible Training and Incredible Results

episodes.synopsis: Kunon gains vision, but is he seeing more than he should? Then, he departs to the magic school.
episodes.title: Kunon the Sorcerer Can See

episodes.synopsis: Kunon and Rinko, who took over as Kunon’s maid in place of Iko, finally arrive at Dirashik.
episodes.title: Farewells and Hellos and Dirashik

episodes.synopsis: Kunon takes the entrance exam with Professor Soff. At the interview, he meets a mysterious sorcerer.
episodes.title: The Advanced Class

episodes.synopsis: Kunon and Reyes work together to find a solution for Reyes’ financial problem.
episodes.title: The Saint's Financial Problem

episodes.synopsis: Kunon asks Hank to cook bacon and Riyah to fly. The three girls try to talk to Kunon but always miss him.
episodes.title: Flying and Roasting and Being Invited

episodes.synopsis: Kunon gets recruited by all three factions. And his response…?
episodes.title: Fairies Checking the Answer

episodes.synopsis: After Kunon passes the test and joins the three factions, he sets sail on the search for a shipwreck.
episodes.title: The Unprecedented Troublemaker
